---
title: "ukhsa data analysis"
author: "Lucie Dvorakova"
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
UKHSA dataset for new HIV diagnoses in England
```{r}
hiv <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-hiv.csv")

gt(head(hiv))
```
graph for the table of new HIV diagnoses
```{r}
ggplot(hiv, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "pink") + 
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Number of New Diagnoses") +
  ggtitle("New HIV Diagnoses")
```
